description: Use for trip-day weather and heat or cold risk at a trailhead, campsite, park entrance or jobsite in the U.S. Returns active National Weather Service alerts (e.g. Heat Advisory, Excessive Heat Warning, Winter Storm Warning, Flash Flood Warning, Red Flag Warning) and the next forecast periods for a latitude/longitude, straight from api.weather.gov, with the forecast page link. U.S. and territories only.

periods.description: Number of 12-hour forecast periods to return

name: get_nws_forecast_and_alerts
title: Live NWS forecast and alerts for a location (U.S.)
